 Sevilla host Osasuna at the Estadio Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán in Seville in a LaLiga fixture that finds both sides in need of a positive result. 
 Luis Garcia's Sevilla come into this match on the back of a bruising 4-1 home defeat to Real Madrid, a result that exposed their defensive vulnerabilities and left them licking their wounds heading into the week. It was a difficult night at the Bernabeu, and the pressure on Garcia to deliver a response is clear. 
 The defeat to Madrid was not an isolated setback. Sevilla have lost three of their last five matches across all competitions, conceding eight goals in the process. A draw with Levante and a win away at Deportivo de A Coruña offer some encouragement, but the team's inconsistency has been a persistent problem. 
 Osasuna arrive in Seville with their own mixed form. Jagoba Arrasate's side picked up a 2-0 win over Racing Santander in their most recent outing but have struggled for consistency, losing three of their last five LaLiga games including a heavy 5-2 reverse at Real Betis. 
 In the table, Sevilla sit in sixth place while Osasuna occupy eleventh, meaning the hosts have a chance to consolidate their position in the upper half while the visitors look to close the gap.
